name: ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueues

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transit router
parameters.name: transit_router_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the inter-region connection
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the QoS policy
parameters.name: traffic_qos_policy_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the queue in the QoS policy
parameters.name: traffic_qos_queue_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the queue in the QoS policy.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
parameters.help_zh:
流量调度策略队列名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: traffic_qos_queue_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the queue in the QoS policy.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`
parameters.help_zh:
流量调度策略队列描述。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: traffic_qos_queue_description

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
A pagination token. It is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

If NextToken is empty, no more results are returned.

If NextToken is not empty, the value of NextToken is used for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

fields.help_en: The actual bandwidth is greater than or equal to the specified value
fields.help_zh: 实际生效带宽大于或等于指定带宽值
fields.name: gte

fields.help_en: The actual bandwidth is less than or equal to the specified value
fields.help_zh: 实际生效带宽小于或等于指定带宽值
fields.name: lte

parameters.help_en: Filters the results by the actual bandwidth. Only positive integers are supported. Unit: Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh: 按照实际的生效带宽值进行过滤，只允许输入正整数，单位Mbps
parameters.name: effective_bandwidth_filter
